title: On a phone a wrapped row meta line ends in a trailing ·, which the iPhone never shows
evidence: From PR 1724 review (H104 area). Web: widget-src/src/components/MyDataRows.tsx:237 (after H104, PR 1722) writes 'target · ' then the date as one nowrap .md-row-date span, so the line can break only after the dot: when the BP or HDL date drops to the second line on a phone, the first line ends in a trailing '·'. iPhone: ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/ValueRow.swift:94-101 uses ViewThatFits, whose fallback stacks the target over the date with no dot. A web/iPhone parity gap. Question for a later change: is hiding the dot on wrap worth it (for example the target and date as two spans, the dot drawn only when they share a line)? Read the live rows at 375 and 390 first. (H112)
